name: se2
description: Capture session proposals as Ideas, plan repository-scoped Features and vertical Tasks, then hand off verified Task execution through shared application contracts.

interface.shortDescription: Capture Ideas and execute verified SE2 Tasks.
interface.longDescription: SE2 is an experimental issue-first, graph-first plugin with explicit Idea capture, Feature planning, and Task implementation entry points. Its Idea skill builds a transient session capture bundle and can preview or publish verified GitHub Ideas through the G-owned issue workflow. Its Feature skill starts from repository AGENTS.md context, keeps a Mermaid overview, a canonical node registry, and one standard Markdown contract for every workflow step. It converges one repository-owned Feature issue containing the canonical Feature definition with vertical Task issues, an acyclic Task dependency graph, readiness evidence, coordinated multi-repository Feature links, and an internally verified GitHub publication step when explicitly authorized. Root plugin contracts standardize live task preflight, destination and identity observation, update relay, and reconciliation; each task-managed skill owns its task profile and topology.
defaultPrompt: Use $se2:feature for an explicit Feature or Feature maintenance run: load repository AGENTS.md context, pass the skill-owned task profile through the shared task preflight when a task handoff is needed, converge repository-owned Feature issues and vertical Task dependency graphs, and return the complete bundle with GitHub verification only when publication is explicitly authorized.

Use $se2:implement only for an explicit SE2 Task implementation request; load the same root task preflight and handoff contracts and fail closed when live creation, observation, or monitoring cannot be verified.

Use $se2:idea for an explicit Idea capture request; build a transient session bundle, preview it without mutation, or publish verified GitHub Ideas through the G-owned issue workflow when publication is explicitly authorized.
